sloka: वधेन ते दाशरथेः सुखार्हं सुखं समाहर्तुमहं व्रजामि ।निहत्य रामं सह लक्ष्मणेन खादामि सर्वान् हरियूथमुख्यान् ।। ६.६३.५६ ।।
transliteration: vadhena te dāśaratheḥ sukhārhaṁ sukhaṁ samāhartumahaṁ vrajāmi ।nihatya rāmaṁ saha lakṣmaṇena khādāmi sarvān hariyūthamukhyān ।। 6.63.56 ।।

translations.english: " All beings all over will be eaten now. For a long time Kumbhakarna was sleeping. Now you will see that the food of all the three worlds, earth, heaven and intermediate region will not be enough to fill my stomach."
